result.title: Introducing GPT-Image-2.5 in the API
result.description:
Meet Sunburst and Flare, our two new GPT-Image-2.5 models. Sunburst brings sharper details, more natural lighting, and greater control across edits. Flare delivers high quality images over 50% faster. Both support transparent backgrounds for assets ranging from infographics to games.

Available now in the API.

result.description:
Have an idea but need help getting started? 

Use templates for popular image formats like posters or merch, then add your message, design elements, or style to make it your own.
ChatGPT Images 2.5 is rolling out today to all ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users across desktop, mobile, and web.

result.title: Sketch with ChatGPT Images 2.5
result.description:
Some ideas are easier to draw than describe. 

Use Sketch to draw right in ChatGPT and show it exactly what you have in mind.
